products.name: Stoneware Mug
products.description: Glazed stoneware, holds heat well and goes in the dishwasher.
products.details: Thrown in small batches and glazed inside and out, so it holds heat as well as it looks doing it. The foot is left unglazed, which stops it sticking to a shelf or a table. The handle is pulled rather than attached, so there is no seam to crack.

products.name: Linen Throw
products.description: Woven European flax, softens with every wash.
products.details: Woven from European flax and washed before it leaves us, so it arrives already soft rather than needing a break-in period. Heavy enough to sit over the back of a chair without sliding. The selvedge is finished by hand.

products.name: Glass Carafe
products.description: Borosilicate glass with a cork stopper, pours without dripping.
products.details: Borosilicate, so it survives a hot liquid being poured straight into it. The cork is a natural stopper with a silicone ring underneath to keep it watertight. The spout is narrow enough to pour clean without running down the side.

specs.Care: Dishwasher safe, hand wash the cork

products.name: Soy Candle
products.description: Rapeseed and coconut wax, unscented, about 40 hours of burn.
products.details: Unscented, so it does not compete with a room or a meal. The wick is cotton and lead-free, and the wax is a rapeseed and coconut blend rather than paraffin, which burns cleaner and keeps its shape in a warm room.

specs.Material: Rapeseed and coconut wax, cotton wick
specs.Care: Trim the wick to 5 mm before each burn

products.name: Ceramic Vase
products.description: Wheel-thrown stoneware with a matte white glaze.
products.details: Wheel-thrown, so no two are identical in a small way: the rim will not be perfectly even, and that is the point of it. Matte white glaze outside, unglazed foot. Holds a full bunch of cut flowers or a single branch.

products.name: Wool Cushion
products.description: Lambswool cover with a feather-down insert, 45cm square.
products.details: Lambswool cover with a feather-down insert, filled firm enough to sit upright on a chair rather than slumping. The cover unzips at the back for washing. The feather is washable, so it can be refilled rather than replaced.

specs.Care: Cover dry clean, fluff by hand

products.name: Serving Bowl
products.description: Shallow glazed bowl, nests with the others to save shelf space.
products.details: Wide and shallow, which is what makes it a serving bowl rather than a mixing bowl: the food stays visible and easy to reach across a table. Glazed inside, so it takes a sauce without soaking it in. Nests with the others.

products.name: Brass Tray
products.description: Unlacquered brass that darkens to a deeper patina over time.
products.details: Unlacquered brass, left uncoated so it darkens to a deeper patina as it is handled instead of staying permanently shiny. Made for keys, a watch, or a small pile of odds and ends. It will not return to bright.

specs.Care: Dry wipe, the patina is intended

collections.title: The Quiet Edit
collections.description: A restrained palette of stoneware, linen and brass chosen to sit easily in an already-lived room.

collections.title: Table & Tide
collections.description: Pieces for the everyday table — mugs, carafes and bowls made to be used daily and washed often.

collections.title: Soft Light
collections.description: Candles and objects that catch a low, late light. Best near a window at the end of the day.
